svg.text: Perfboard layout — 34 mm disc, 2.54 mm pitch (top / component side)
Kapton under it; BAT+/BAT− wires from
its underside pads drop through I7 / I8
● blue = XIAO castellation soldered to that pad
● amber = transistor / LED lead in that hole
adjacent pads, soldered on the underside
- - - dashed = insulated wire on the underside
BAT+ I7 → H3, D3, C9 (Q1 source)
GND I8 → J3, C3, D10, H11, SW1
D1 (K4) ← SW1 tact switch, other leg to GND
D2 (J4) → B4 100Ω → C4 Q3 gate; 100k C3–C4
Q3 drain C5 → D5 LED cathode; D4 anode → 82Ω → D3 BAT+
Q2 drain D12 → D9 Q1 gate; 100k C9–D9 pulls it up
Q1 drain B9 → G11 = switched rail → ring VDD
C1 100 µF across G11 (+) / H11 (−), ring GND → H11
Cut a 34 mm disc; only holes ≤16 mm from centre are used.
TO-92s lie flat (toward the edge); ring sits on 4.5 mm
standoffs to clear the XIAO's USB-C. Verify the XIAO pin
order against its silkscreen before soldering.
B6/C6/D6 are the adapter's unused row — leave them open.
